findings.issue:
The upload failure toast reads 'Error: ' + result.error, for example 'Failed to parse game file: Parser error: No frontmatter found. File must start with --- frontmatter ---'. That is three error prefixes and markdown jargon, in a toast that disappears after 5s. Other failure messages:

plan.spec: DECISIONS. VT's own spec says the game reviewer's tier boundaries win and VT's colours, alphas and mechanism stand. Both are applied, and every number also stays inside both reviewers' caps. - Kings tiers 0-2 / 3-4 (GD). VT-1-15's label rule makes the label red from the first King, separately from the tint tier. - Stability critical is .14, pulsing to .07 (VT's ceiling). It stays under Kings .16, and GD's rule holds: Kings 3-4 and Stability critical are the strongest; every other tier is ≤.12. - Aces use GD's boundaries and alphas (.04/.07/.10/.12, and gold for Easy's fourth). They sit inside VT's ceiling; VT's .14 for four Aces broke GD's .12 cap. - Cards use GD's boundaries (13 and 7) with VT's colours and alphas. - Tokens turn green at 2 or fewer (GD). The owner asked that 'the value's colour changes with' the tier, and VT's yellow-only ladder keeps Tokens one colour from unlock to 0. - Roll: one tier per pending modifier, at .10 (VT). Lucid is on from the natural 20 until the next result lands, so 'natural 20' and 'Lucid pending' are one span of play. GD's separate .06 'pending over another value' only differs while dice are in flight, when the LED shows '--' (GD-1-16). - Glow: one recipe, 0 0 6px at 45% of the value colour (VT). Only Kings 3-4 keeps 0 0 10px rgba(255,77,109,.8). - The locked Tokens max is .5 (VT, 5.36:1), which passes GD-1-19's zero-fail acceptance. A. TIER FUNCTIONS (hudTiers.js, pure, exported, unit-tested at every boundary): - stabilityTier(n): existing. - kingsTier(n): 'calm' for 0-2, 'urgent' for 3-4. - rollTier({ hasRolled, isLucid, isSurreal }): 'lucid' if isLucid (Lucid wins), else 'surreal' if isSurreal, else 'plain' if hasRolled, else 'idle'. - cardsTier(n): 'full' for 13 and up, 'low' for 7-12, 'out' for 6 or fewer. - acesTier({ count, heartsAce, fourthWins }), in this order: 'none' at 0; 'final' at 4 with fourthWins; 'four' at 4; 'locked' for 1-3 without the Ace of Hearts; then 'one', 'two', 'three'. - tokensTier({ unlocked, tokens, start }), in this order: 'locked'; 'over' if tokens > start; 'clear' if 0; 'near' if ≤2; 'half' if ≤ start/2; 'full'. plan.title: Home messages: plain upload and save errors, consistent confirm dialogs, punctuation
plan.spec:
1. UPLOAD ERRORS. In stores/customGames.js, add friendlyUploadError(error): it maps the parser's ValidationError messages to plain reasons. The parser itself is unchanged, so its tests stand.
- 'No frontmatter found' and 'Invalid frontmatter format' → "it doesn't start with a --- block"
- 'Missing required frontmatter fields: X' → 'it has no X'
- 'No "## Card Deck" section found' → 'it has no Card Deck section'
- 'File too large' → "it's larger than 100KB"
- any card-count list → "its deck doesn't have the cards the format needs"
- anything else → "it isn't a valid game file"
addCustomGame returns { success: false, reason } and +page.svelte writes the toast.
2. TOAST COPY (+page.svelte):
- Wrong file type: 'Choose a file that ends in .game.md.'
- Parse failure: 'Couldn't add “{file name}”: {reason}. Fix the file and upload it again.'
- Storage failure: "Couldn't save the game in this browser. Free up some space and try again."
- Unknown error: "Couldn't add that file. Try again, or check it opens in a text editor."
- Bad save: "That save couldn't be opened. Start a new game or delete the save."
- Success: 'Added “{title}”' (curly quotes).
- No 'Error:', 'Failed' or 'Parser' prefix.
3. TOAST BEHAVIOUR (Toast.svelte): error toasts are role=alert, stay at least 10s and can be dismissed. Other toasts stay role=status with their current timing.
4. CONFIRM DIALOGS (+page.svelte): cancel 'Keep <object>', confirm '<Verb> <object>'.
- Delete save: 'Delete your {game} save (Round {n})? This can't be undone.' Buttons 'Keep save' / 'Delete save'.
- New game: 'Start {game} from the beginning? Your Round {n} save will be replaced. This can't be undone.' Buttons 'Keep my save' / 'Start new game'.
- Remove game: 'Remove {game} from your games? To play it again, upload its file.' Buttons 'Keep game' / 'Remove game'.
5. FIRST-RUN (FirstRunPanel): the button reads 'I know how to play: skip the tips', with no full stop.

- Each toast matches the copy above, has no 'Error:', 'Failed' or 'Parser' prefix, and stays at least 10s.

- No dialog says 'Keep it' or 'for good'.

CP (CP-1-18):
